segments.speaker: JUDY
segments.en: Good morning.Total Insurance.Judy speaking, how may I help you?

segments.speaker: MICHAEL
segments.en: I recently shipped my belongingsfrom overseas back here to Australia and I took out insurancewith your company. Some items were damaged during the move so I need to make a claim. What do I have to do?

segments.speaker: JUDY
segments.en: Okay, well first I need to get a few details about this. Can you give me your name please?

segments.speaker: MICHAEL
segments.en: Yes. It's Michael Alexander.

segments.speaker: JUDY
segments.en: Okay. And your address please?

segments.speaker: MICHAEL
segments.en: My old address or my current one?

segments.speaker: JUDY
segments.en: Your current one.

segments.speaker: MICHAEL
segments.en: It's 24 Manly Street, Milperranear Sydney.

segments.speaker: JUDY
segments.en: What was the suburb, sorry?

segments.speaker: MICHAEL
segments.en: Milperra. M-1-L-P-E-R-R-A. 01

segments.speaker: JUDY
segments.en: Right. Now, who was the shippingagent Mr Alexander?

segments.speaker: MICHAEL
segments.en: You mean the companywe used?

segments.speaker: JUDY
segments.en: Yes, the companywho packedeverythingup atthe point of origin.

segments.speaker: MICHAEL
segments.en: Oh, it was ... er ... First Class Movers. 02

segments.speaker: JUDY
segments.en: Okay ... where were the goods shipped from?

segments.speaker: MICHAEL
segments.en: China, but the ship came via Singaporeand was there for about a week.

segments.speaker: JUDY
segments.en: Don't worry, all of that informationwill be in the documentation.Now, the dates. Do you know when the ship arrived?

segments.speaker: MICHAEL
segments.en: It left on the 11th of Octoberand got to Sydney on the 28th of November. 03

segments.speaker: JUDY
segments.en: Okay. I need one more thing. There's a referencenumber. It should be in the top right-handcorner of the pink form they gave you.

segments.speaker: MICHAEL
segments.en: Let me have a look. I have so many papers.Yes, here it is. It's 601 ACK.

segments.speaker: JUDY
segments.en: Thanks.

segments.speaker: JUDY
segments.en: I need to take down a few details of the actual damage over the phone before you put in a full report. Can you tell me how many items were damaged and what the damage was?

segments.speaker: MICHAEL
segments.en: Yes, well four things actually. I'll start with the big things. My TV first of all. It's a large one ... very expensive.

segments.speaker: JUDY
segments.en: Our insurance doesn't cover electrical problems.

segments.speaker: MICHAEL
segments.en: It isn't an electrical problem. The screen has a huge crack in it so it's 04 unusable.

segments.speaker: JUDY
segments.en: I see. Any idea of the price to repair it?

segments.speaker: MICHAEL
segments.en: No. Well, I don't think it can be repaired. It will need a new one. 04

segments.speaker: JUDY
segments.en: Okay. I'll make a note of that and we'll see what we can do. Now, what was the second item?

segments.speaker: MICHAEL
segments.en: The cabinet from the bathroom was damagedas well. It's a lovely cabinet, 05 we use it to keep our towels in.

segments.speaker: JUDY
segments.en: And what is the extent of the damage?

segments.speaker: MICHAEL
segments.en: Well, the back and the sides seem okay but the door has a huge hole in it. 06 It can't be repaired. I'm really not very happy about it.

segments.speaker: JUDY
segments.en: And how much do you think it will cost to replace it?

segments.speaker: MICHAEL
segments.en: Well, when I bought it last year I paid $125 for it. But the one I've seen here in Sydney is a bit more expensive, it's $140. 07

segments.speaker: JUDY
segments.en: Right, and what was the third item?

segments.speaker: MICHAEL
segments.en: My dining room table. It's a IQvelytable from Indonesia.It must have been very hot inside the container because one leg has completely split down 08 the middle. The top and the other three look okay thank goodness.

segments.speaker: JUDY
segments.en: Any idea of the price to repair it?

segments.speaker: MICHAEL
segments.en: Well, I had an estimate done on this actually because it is a very special table to us. They quoted us $200, which is really pricey so I hope the insurancewill cover the total cost.

segments.speaker: JUDY
segments.en: I'm sure that will be fine. What was the last item, Mr Alexander?

segments.speaker: MICHAEL
segments.en: Well, we have a lovely set of china plates and dishes, you know, with matching cups, saucers, the lot. They were all in the one box which must have got dropped because some plates were broken - six actually. 09

segments.speaker: JUDY
segments.en: And can you tell me the replacementvalue of these?

segments.speaker: MICHAEL
segments.en: Well, it's hard to say because they were part of a set but they can be up to $10 each as it's such a good set.

segments.speaker: JUDY
segments.en: Okay, so that would be around $60 altogether? 010

segments.speaker: MICHAEL
segments.en: Yes, that's right.

segments.speaker: JUDY
segments.en: And is that all of the items?

segments.speaker: MICHAEL
segments.en: Yes. So what do I have to do now?
